objective: Hide the next-frame cold discovery wait behind the operator's review time without changing the established single-image inference path.

implementation.trigger: three seconds after the current frame candidate is displayed
implementation.target: the immediately adjacent next frame only
implementation.busy_policy: retry every five seconds, at most twelve attempts
implementation.cancellation: navigation away from the source frame invalidates the timer and all later attempts
skip_conditions: next frame is outside the file
next frame already has human truth
next frame already has a machine candidate
file, topic, label registry or source-frame binding changed

dynamic_scheduler_contract: no request before the three-second dwell
busy status schedules a low-frequency retry
idle status requests frame source+1 with the same file and topic binding

validation_environment_note: The formal runtime directory contains a historical non-authoritative test mirror. Its direct full-suite attempt exposed stale tests and was stopped; the two temporarily copied tests were restored byte-for-byte. The version-controlled worktree full suite and the deployed runtime API/browser checks are the acceptance sources.

decision.reason: The scheduler preserves the validated single-image semantic path, real prefetch and exact reuse work, navigation cancellation is executable-tested, and all formal state files remain unchanged.

limits: The 95.426 percent figure compares one cold request with an immediate exact-cache repeat; it is not a cross-dataset P50 or P95.
The optimization moves existing computation earlier and does not reduce first-image VLM compute.
No SAM3 fine-tuning or VLM post-training was performed in this round.
